Name: Dried Red Mushrooms and Truffles
Author: fireredlily
Description:
Tired of your red mushrooms not turning a profit? Ever wondered why your truffles could only be turned into truffle oil? This tiny Content Patcher mod turns your Red Mushrooms and Truffles into Dried gourmet goods that provide more profit when sold, compared to their unprocessed forms.

[b]How it works:[/b]
By default, only edible mushrooms (those with the [i]edible_mushroom[/i] context tag) can be dehydrated for extra profit as a gourmet product. This mod adds a new rule to the Dehydrator to accept mushrooms with a new[i] inedible_mushroom[/i] tag, and applies the new tag to Red Mushrooms and Truffles. The [i]inedible_mushroom[/i] tag[b] [u]does not[/u][/b] prevent players from eating the mushrooms or the Dried variants, should they so choose.

[size=3][b]Mod compatibility:[/b][/size]
Other mods can add their own poisonous or inedible mushrooms to the dehydrator's accepted list by adding the context tag [i]inedible_mushroom[/i] to their object data fields. I do not guarantee any compatibility with other mods that may created upgraded dehydrators.

Created based on [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1277#issue-2434146298]DZK312's request[/url] from the SDV mod-ideas Github!

Downloads.Description: A tiny mod that lets players put Red Mushrooms and Truffles in the Dehydrator to get gourmet Dried Red Mushrooms and Dried Truffles. Requires Content Patcher 2.4.0 or higher.
